metadata.document: Environmental Defence Society submission on the Fast-track Approvals Bill

cleaned_body_text: The Environmental Defence Society (EDS) thanks the Environment Select Committee for the opportunity to make a submission on the Fast-track Approvals Bill. EDS strongly opposes the Bill, viewing it as an environmental destruction bill that circumvents environmental considerations and undermines established protections. The submission outlines concerns regarding project eligibility, expert panel processes, ministerial decision-making powers, public participation, and the Bill's consistency with international free trade agreements and conservation laws.
